name: PLATO LPopt Benchmark
description: Evaluates LP solvers on finding optimal basic (vertex) solutions for 56 large-scale instances (40 disclosed, 16 undisclosed), drawn from MIPlib 2010, Netlib, and SZTAKI subcollections. Problems span up to 38 million columns and 93 million nonzeros. The benchmark compares both commercial and open-source solvers including simplex and interior-point implementations.
typical_sota_score: COPT leads (scaled mean 1.0, 65/65 solved); MOSEK and HiGHS competitive. 15,000-second time limit.
reputation: Standard LP optimality benchmark maintained by Hans Mittelmann; reference for LP solver comparisons in OR literature.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark. 16 of 56 instances are undisclosed to prevent solver tuning. Problem scale: rows up to 7M, columns up to 38M, nonzeros up to 93M.
